content: {"episode_id":"ep-05165","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1) and underlying atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Because these symptoms are intermittent, continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period is required to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management. The monitoring was therefore medically necessary as documented in the clinical indication note, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial."}
